tools.name: verify_usdt_payment
tools.description: Confirms whether an address received a specific amount of genuine USDT within a time window on Tron, Ethereum, BNB Chain, Polygon, Arbitrum, Base. Ignores fake tokens that copy the USDT name. Use before releasing goods, crediting an account or marking an invoice paid. Costs $0.005 per call in USDC o

tools.name: tron_address_risk
tools.description: Scores an address on Tron, Ethereum, BNB Chain, Polygon, Arbitrum, Base for address-poisoning look-alikes, dust and zero-value attacks, fake-USDT deposits and missing history. Pass "expected" to detect a look-alike of the address you meant to pay. Use before any outgoing USDT transfer. Costs $0.01 p

tools.name: tron_usdt_transfers
tools.description: Returns recent confirmed transfers of genuine USDT for an address on Tron, Ethereum, BNB Chain, Polygon, Arbitrum, Base as clean JSON with decimal amounts, direction and explorer links. Fake tokens are filtered out. Costs $0.002 per call in USDC on Base, Polygon or Arbitrum (x402).
